title: Nafaha Godka
intro: Waxaad dib ugu laabanaysaa xilligii uu taliye naxariis daran dalbaday in si buuxda loogu adeego ilaahyo been ah. Bulsho yar oo nafo u heellan ayaa diiday, waxayna la kulantay ciqaab aad u daran oo ay noqotay mid weligeed la habaaray. Sheekadoodu waxay ka soo dhex baxaysaa Qur'aanka si ay u noqoto markhaati u ah iimaanka aan kala go'a lahayn. Ma aqoonsan kartaa kooxdan adag?
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn dhul uu ka talin jiray hoggaamiye dalban jiray caabudidda ilaahyo been ah
Bulshadeennu waxay la kulantay cadaadis xooggan oo keliya sababtoo ah iimaankeenna Alle oo keliya awgeed
Taliyuhu wuxuu amray in god weyn la qodo oo lagu shido olol xooggan
Maadaama aan diidnay inaan ka noqonno iimaankeenna, waxaa mid mid naloogu tuuray godkaas ololaya.
Sheekadeennu waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah Qur'aanka, kuwii na dhibaateeyayna way nacdaleen weligood.
Suuradda diiwaan gelisa dhibkeenna waxaa loogu magac daray calaamadaha cirka ee waaweyn.

options: Asxaabta Godka (Ashab al-Ukhdud)
Dadka Godka (Ashab al-Kahf)
Dadka Sabtida
Dadka reer Aaad

trial.label: Tijaabadeenna
options: In lagu gubo nolol god dab ah
Sannado badan oo god lagu xirayay
Kalluumeysiga maalinta barakaysan ee nasashada
Waxaa burburiya dabaysha ciyeysa
Dilka geel barakeysan
trial.answer: In lagu gubo nolol god dab ah

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: God dab ah oo ololaya
God qarsoon oo ay la socdaan ey daacad ah
Tiirar dhaadheer oo magaalo qadiimi ah oo halaagsamay ah
Guryo buuro ah oo loo xardhay dhagaxyo dhagax ah
Bannaan bannaan oo ay dabaylo xooggan qaadeen

outcome.label: Natiijooyinkeena
options: Waan shahiiday, kuwa silciyana waa la habaaray weligood
Waxaan soo toosnay ka dib markii aan hurudnay 309 sano
Xadgudubkeenna awgiis ayaa naloo beddelay daanyeerro
Dabayl xoog leh oo qaylinaysa ayaa na wada baabi'isay
Oohin xun oo keliya ayaa burburisay jiritaankeenna
outcome.answer: Waan shahiiday, kuwa silciyana waa la habaaray weligood

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
